disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of the parties (except property management)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except in a case involving property management, acts for more than 1 party in a transaction without the knowledge of the parties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide a written agency disclosure to a prospective buyer or seller as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Does not provide a written agency disclosure to a prospective buyer or seller in a real estate transaction as required under section 2517.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Associate broker or salesperson representing a broker other than employer without express knowledge and consent of employer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the licensee is an associate real estate broker or real estate salesperson, represents or attempts to represent a real estate broker other than the licensee's employer without the express knowledge and consent of the employer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for or remit money belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Does not account for or does not remit money that comes into the licensee's possession that belongs to others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Changing a business location without notifying the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Changes a business location without notification to the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Real estate broker failing to return a salesperson's license within 5 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the licensee is a real estate broker, does not return a real estate salesperson's license within 5 days under section 2507.
If the licensee engaged in property management, violates section 2512c(2), (5), or (6).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sharing or paying a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration to an unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as provided in section 2510(2), shares or pays a fee, commission, or other valuable consideration to a person that is not licensed under this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting or developing a market analysis that does not comply with statutory requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducts or develops a market analysis that does not comply with section 2601(a)(ii).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide the minimum services specified under a service provision agreement unless waived in writing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Does not provide the minimum services specified under section 2512d(3) when providing services under a service provision agreement unless expressly waived in writing by the client under section 2517(2).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deposit client funds in a custodial trust or escrow account or commingling funds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A real estate broker shall not deposit or permit the deposit of an advance payment of money that belongs to others in the real estate broker's business or personal account or commingle or permit the commingling of that money with funds on deposit that belong to the real estate broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a void and unenforceable right-to-list home sale agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Enters into a void and unenforceable right-to-list home sale agreement as described in section 2512g.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of embezzlement or misappropriation of funds bars licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall not issue a real estate broker's license to an individual who has been convicted of embezzlement or misappropriation of funds.

bonding_required.quote: If an application for a license is made by a person whose license has been denied, suspended, or revoked as a result of disciplinary action for violation of this article or of the rules promulgated under this article, the department may require as a condition precedent to the issuance of a license to the applicant or the removal of suspension, that the applicant file or have on file with the department a bond

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A real estate broker shall maintain a place of business in this state. If a real estate broker maintains more than 1 place of business in this state, the real estate broker must obtain a branch office license for each of those additional places of business.

definition_quote.value: Real estate broker means an individual or business entity that, with intent to collect or receive a fee, compensation, or valuable consideration, sells or offers for sale, buys or offers to buy, provides or offers to provide market analyses of, lists or offers or attempts to list, or negotiates the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate; that negotiates the mortgage of real estate; that negotiates for the construction of a building on real estate; that leases or offers or rents or offers for rent real estate or the improvements on the real estate for others, as a whole or partial vocation; that engages in property management as a whole or partial vocation; that sells or offers for sale, buys or offers to buy, leases or offers to lease, or negotiates the purchase or sale or exchange of a business, business opportunity, or the goodwill of an existing business for others; or that, as owner or otherwise, engages in the sale of real estate as a principal vocation.
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" means an individual or business entity that, with intent to collect or receive a fee, compensation, or valuable consideration, sells or offers for sale, buys or offers to buy, provides or offers to provide market analyses of, lists or offers or attempts to list, or negotiates the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate; that negotiates the mortgage of real estate; that negotiates for the construction of a building on real estate; that leases or offers or rents or offers for rent real estate or the improvements on the real estate for others, as a whole or partial vocation; that engages in property management as a whole or partial vocation

exam_application_window_years.quote: A passing score on an examination, or on a portion of an examination if the examination is given in separate parts, is valid for 1 year from the date of the examination.

inactive_license_max_years.quote: The department may relicense without examination an individual who fails to renew a license issued under this article within the time period described in subsection (2) if all of the following are met: (a) The individual applies within 3 years after the expiration date of the person's last license.

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: An individual whose license is revoked shall not apply for a new license for at least 3 years after the service of the final order of the revocation.

agency_relationship_types.quote: A real estate licensee can be the agent of both the seller and the buyer in a transaction, but only with the knowledge and informed consent, in writing, of both the seller and the buyer.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A real estate licensee can be the agent of both the seller and the buyer in a transaction, but only with the knowledge and informed consent, in writing, of both the seller and the buyer.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A broker and a client may enter into a designated agency agreement.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: This article does not prevent a licensee from acting as a transaction coordinator upon proper notice to all parties to a real estate transaction.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A licensee shall disclose to a potential buyer or seller in a real estate transaction all types of agency relationships available and the licensee's duties that each agency relationship creates before the disclosure by the potential buyer or seller to the licensee of any confidential information specific to that potential buyer or seller.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: "Service provision agreement" means a buyer agency agreement or listing agreement that is executed by a real estate broker and a client and establishes an agency relationship.

value: At the time of execution of an offer to purchase, a licensee shall recommend to the purchaser that the purchaser require that the seller provide a fee title policy in the amount of the purchase price
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: At the time of execution of an offer to purchase, a licensee shall recommend to the purchaser that the purchaser require that the seller provide a fee title policy in the amount of the purchase price to the purchaser, issued or certified to the approximate date of closing of the real estate transaction.

escrow_account_required.quote: A real estate broker shall deposit, not later than 2 banking days after the broker has received notice that an offer to purchase is accepted by all parties, money that belongs to others and is made payable to the real estate broker into a separate custodial trust or escrow account maintained by the real estate broker

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: A real estate broker shall deposit, not later than 2 banking days after the broker has received notice that an offer to purchase is accepted by all parties, money that belongs to others and is made payable to the real estate broker into a separate custodial trust or escrow account

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: A real estate broker shall not deposit or permit the deposit of an advance payment of money that belongs to others in the real estate broker's business or personal account or commingle or permit the commingling of that money with funds on deposit that belong to the real estate broker.

fixed_office_required.quote: A real estate broker shall maintain a place of business in this state.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: If a branch office is located more than 25 miles from the nearest boundary of the municipality in which the main office of the real estate broker is located, the broker shall ensure that the branch office is under the direct supervision of an associate broker.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: An application for a real estate salesperson's license shall be signed by the real estate broker that will employ the applicant.
